scope: Art-direction comparison; changed procedural vegetation and lighting, not a matched quality/performance optimization claim
reuse_tier: G; greenfield implementation, no old renderer port
reference_qualification: Same world/camera/light. 1920x1080, pixel-error 4.5 (same angular error as 1280x720 at 3), native plant geometry and 2048-square near shadow map. Terrain remains adaptive with finite plant ranges. Not path-traced or full-world exact.
benchmark_scope: Short uncapped settled laptop runs: static 1080p at pixel-error 4.5; moving 720p at pixel-error 3 and 3 m/s. Opaque GPU query excludes atmosphere and shadows; whole-frame intervals include presentation. Not a 60 FPS claim.

tests.shaders: Naga validates1x/4x atmosphere variants, vegetation and shadows
tests.primary: PNG, linear RGB, depth and coverage buffers all byte-identical to frozen pre-change baseline; primary-regression.json

generated_assets: Every plant full-record seed and habitat/growth rules. Mesh caches retain derived geometry, never pick copied plant assets.
